description:
Quality-govern an in-progress AI generation step BEFORE its output is
    used (complements validate, which checks finished documents). Returns
    an action - STOP, CONTINUE, REPAIR_REGION, REUSE_MOTIF, REVIEW,
    ESCALATE - with a plain-language explanation. Structural scores do not
    establish task correctness. Check safe_to_finalize and acceptance coverage.
    Persistence success is reported; read traces in the same Blueprint namespace.
